title: _claimRewards underflows and reverts after pauseWithdraw -> unpause -> claim sequence
description: After a user partially exits via pauseWithdraw, their user.amount is decremented while user.phUSDDebt and user.stableDebt are left unchanged. On the next pause-unpause cycle, when the user calls claim/withdraw/stake, _claimRewards computes (userDetails.amount * accPerShare) / PRECISION - userDetails.<token>Debt with a stale debt anchored to the pre-withdraw (larger) amount. For any reasonable parameterization this expression underflows (Panic 0x11) and reverts the entire entrypoint.
impact: Permanent DoS of the normal claim/withdraw/stake path for any user who has ever partially exited via pauseWithdraw. The user's accrued phUSD and stable rewards on the remaining stake become unclaimable (in-motion yield loss). Principal is NOT lost — the user can still recover it via a subsequent full pauseWithdraw during a future pause, but doing so forfeits all accrued rewards. Per C4 special cases, in-motion yield loss is capped at Medium even with a verified counterexample.
attackPath: Time elapses; accumulators grow; user accrues rewards.
Pauser legitimately pauses the contract (documented operation).
User calls pauseWithdraw(partial_amount) — valid input per the function signature.
User calls claim() / withdraw(remaining) / stake — all revert with Panic 0x11 because (user.amount * accPerShare) / PRECISION < stale user.debt.
Only recovery is another full pauseWithdraw during a future pause, forfeiting all accrued rewards.
likelihood: high — only requires a standard pause cycle plus a partial pauseWithdraw (both valid protocol operations); no privileged or unusual inputs
assumptions: Pauser performs at least one pause cycle (documented operational scenario)
externalRequirements: Pause triggered (by trusted pauser or governance)
recommendation: Inside pauseWithdraw, after decrementing user.amount, rebase user.phUSDDebt and user.stableDebt to the new amount: user.phUSDDebt = (user.amount * accPhUSDPerShare) / PRECISION; user.stableDebt = (user.amount * accStablePerShare) / PRECISION. Also call _updatePool() before the rebase so accumulators are current. Mirror this fix in pendingPhUSD/pendingStable view helpers (see L-14).

poc.notes: Witness 100e18 + pause/unpause/partial-pauseWithdraw sequence reproduces Panic 0x11. To be authored by poc-generator.

classifierRationale: Principal recoverable via pauseWithdraw; impact is in-motion yield loss (capped at Medium per C4 special cases). Verified by INV-01 + SYMBOLIC-001/002.
